description: This file defines the IntegrationException class, a custom exception that extends ServiceException, used within the integration module of the sales management system.

classes.name: IntegrationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling integration-related errors within the system, providing additional error details such as error code and error fields.

methods.name: IntegrationException
methods.description: Constructors to initialize IntegrationException with various levels of detail (message, cause, error code, etc.).

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the specific error code associated with this exception.

methods.name: setErrorCode
methods.description: Sets the error code for this exception.

methods.name: getErrorFields
methods.description: Retrieves the list of error fields associated with this exception.

methods.name: setErrorFields
methods.description: Sets the list of error fields that relate to this exception.
